newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - T-bonds set to slide, aim for 109-16.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - T-bonds set to slide, aim for 109-16.

text.p: U.S. T-bonds are poised to come off slightly on Monday, but as long as they hold above 109-15,16, medium term upside potential remains intact, technical analysts said.
"I expect the market to drift lower today, I'm looking at 109-22 and 109-16," said Donna Liu, technical analyst at DKB International here.
She said the upside should be limited to 110-14.
"The market has really been trying between 110-10 and 110-22 for the last few days but the upward momentum was not really there," said Liu.
"We had very good data last week but we could not rally through it, so I think upside ahould be limited about the mid-range at 110-14."
By 0853 GMT, the June T-bond was up 2/32 at 110-01.
Elizabeth Miller, technical anlayst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell here, put initial support at 109-27, a period of intra-day congestion.
Below there, the May 15 low at 109-12 -- when the market spiked down -- will provide more support, she said, followed by a prop at 108-30.
She put resistance at Friday's high at 110-16, then 110-22, the high from May 13 which has capped the market recently.
By 0858 GMT, September Eurodollars were down 0.005 at 93.890.
